notes.title: [Patch] Planting Trees Navigation Patch
notes.content: We have made some small improvements to the game's navigation that may improve the experience while playing.

notes.title: [Update] Bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we appreciate your patience, we know that although it is an early access game, it is expected that at least the game can be opened.

We had a problem with the Steam web api which resulted in not being able to open the game, because the game needs the web api to work. The problem has been solved, everyone can play the game.

We will update the game so that the game can come out of early access soon, enjoy!
